permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Connects to Telegram, straight from your phone, to read the chats you pick and send what you confirm. A hold to talk sends its sound to Paper Plane's relay to be turned into words. If you connect Google Calendar, your next meeting is read from Google and a meeting you confirm is added.

permissions.name: g2-microphone
permissions.desc: Hold the touchpad to talk: to say a reply, or to go somewhere in the app by voice.
